description: The one Capture window opens the folder Capture keeps its files in, chosen on first run and remembered as folder in its settings.md, and bound by Rust before its WebView exists. The page opens it as Capture's contract client (openDevice from @epicenter/folder/tauri) and passes no path. It lists, reads and writes its folder through the folder plugin's private observation and close channels; on close it waits for queued writes, then destroys the window. It may read the folder's path (folder_path) to ask Epicenter, through the folder plugin, to sync it (epicenter://init) and whether Epicenter already does. It may ask to choose another folder (choose_folder), which opens a native picker and moves the window there.
